derived_controls: height difference requires two accepted real elevation samples
both elevation samples must use compatible vertical datum
survey epoch context must be retained for both samples
same-raster or shared-lineage errors must not be treated as independent
EA 1m remains primary terrain numeric evidence
OS Terrain50 remains coarse independent corroboration
datum-transform error remains separate from terrain-model error
no height-difference row is emitted when any mandatory component is missing
quality_effect: Prevents false precision in pairwise height difference and keeps correlated uncertainty components explicit.
